_readme: Copy to config/settings.json (gitignored) and edit there. Keys named 'mac' / 'windows' are picked by OS: sys.platform 'darwin' -> mac, 'win32' -> windows.

flipper._led_note: The Flipper LED is off except at ALARM (red + 3 buzzes). The firmware's charge indicator owns red/green while listening, so mode colours were dropped (2026-11-14). The dashboard shows mode colours on screen with its own defaults.

llm._note: Bonsai 2 via LM Studio OpenAI-compatible server only. Pick a profile; NV laptop uses nv_backup.
llm._models: model = the smart Bonsai (9B: visitor conversation, confrontation, summary, vision). fast_model = the small Bonsai (2B: threat label, quick owner commands). On Windows the 4B stands in for both.

mac._note: Exact id of the loaded 9B on the Mac mini (checked 2026-11-14). The 27B models installed there are NOT allowed; start_mac.sh fails unless this one is the loaded model.

diarize._note: Speaker count for visitor recordings -> speech_heard.voices. Flags unconfirmed: check `argmax-cli diarize --help` on the Mac. grace_s: how long STT may wait for it (0 = never delays the reply).

mac._note: Tested on the Mac mini: --play streams straight to the speaker. voice adds a fixed --seed (argmax-cli otherwise picks a random seed per line, so the voice drifts), a lower --temperature (CLI default 0.9), --top-k and the model (0.6b, or 1.7b with an instruction). Every line is also saved to cache/tts so repeats are instant and identical; prerender renders the fixed lines at startup. Pick the voice with: python3 -m hardware.tts_audition

audio._note: Hands-free: one mic stream stays open. Audio is used only in listening windows (after a doorbell, after a question, after the wake phrase) and dropped while Faraday speaks. A window opens after_speech_s after Faraday has finished everything it had to say, lasts up to max_s, ends silence_s after the speaker stops or after no_speech_s if nobody spoke. The wake listener cuts speech into segments at wake.silence_s pauses.

security._note: Plain words, no digits. Matching ignores case and punctuation and accepts number words written as digits. Change it in your settings.json.
